name: MCP Servers Registry
description: Installs an idempotent configure-mcp.sh applier that reads a JSON registry of MCP servers and merges them into each detected agent's native config format (Claude, Codex, Devin, Cursor, Copilot). The registry content is a plain JSON file in the project, not a feature option; the registryPath option only overrides its location.

registryPath.description: Path (relative to workspace folder or absolute) to the JSON registry of MCP servers. The file format is {"serverName": {"url": "https://..."}} for remote servers or {"serverName": {"command": "...", "args": [...]}} for stdio servers.
